==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity through sleep paralysis. I interrogated the Death Witch in the dungeon. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Death Witch resembles a woman, pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, a belt made of skulls.) She revealed that the Death Staff is a treefolk from Hell that she sold her soul to summon. (The Death Staff resembles a a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy.) (I don't know what the Death Staff's true demon form actually looks like. The Death Staff itself of course wasn't present, as it is currently on Golem Planet.) Until the witch dies, the demon is trapped outside of Hell as the Death Staff.
